Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production 2D video game animation sprite atlas for Yautja: The Long Hunt.
The three supplied pictures are REFERENCE IMAGES ONLY for the Predator/Yautja design and arboreal poses. Make new isolated game sprites, not an edited photograph.
Create one square TRANSPARENT RGBA sprite sheet, ideally 2048x2048, EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows: 16 equal square cells, no cell borders or gaps, no text, no numbers. Chronological animation reads left to right then next row. One whole-body character in every cell with ample transparent padding; nothing crosses a cell boundary.
ANIMATION A / ENTER BRANCH CROUCH. A single SAME classic masked jungle Yautja in every frame, grounded anatomical realistic hand-painted HD 2D game sprite style, crisp readable silhouette and restrained contrast, no black outline. Mottled tan/olive skin, black net body suit, same worn gunmetal-silver bio-mask, dark dreadlocks with bronze bands, one left-shoulder plasma cannon, matching shoulder plates, chest harness, wrist gauntlets, loincloth, knee/shin armor, clawed feet. Weapons stowed. Maintain identical equipment, proportions, colors, light direction, camera distance and orientation through all 16 frames.
Fixed orthographic three-quarter front view, face slightly toward screen right. Use reference image 1 for the exact final low crouched branch-perch stance: hips low, knees deeply folded, forward knee raised, forearm resting lightly across it, head lowered watching the ground, feet braced. The branch is INVISIBLE: do not draw a tree, branch, ground, shadow, leaves or backdrop.
Frame choreography: F01 balanced upright ready pose feet already on the invisible branch; F02 slight downward head anticipation; F03 knees unlock; F04 hips begin lowering; F05 knees bend 25 percent; F06 chest inclines slightly; F07 hips lower further; F08 near arm moves toward raised knee; F09 deeper controlled squat; F10 weight transfers over planted feet; F11 knee tucked and forearm nearing contact; F12 forearm contacts knee; F13 hips settle low; F14 head settles into watchful lowered angle; F15 small follow-through of dreadlocks; F16 stable low compact crouch matching reference 1.
Very gradual consecutive changes, eased start and finish, meaningful separate drawings. Feet contact points remain exactly fixed within each cell throughout: near foot at about 54% width, 86% height; far foot slightly left and 7% higher, as on a slanted branch. Standing pose head at 12% cell height; crouch is anatomically smaller vertically because hips lower; do NOT zoom to fill the cell. Keep complete head/cannon/dreadlocks/hands/clawed feet visible. No duplicated still pose grid; no ghosting or motion blur; no additional limbs; no props.
Background MUST be true transparent alpha, not a painted checkerboard or white rectangle. This is usable sprite art, not a presentation poster.

Main grip never slides, fingers grip rather than float, arms never stretch, no extra limbs. Smooth controlled motion without ghosting or blur. Preserve true transparent background. No tree, branch, terrain, shadows, effects or additional character.
